verdict.rationale: Datalab's core conversion outputs (Markdown, HTML, JSON) inherently carry some structural information (headings, sections) and its segmentation feature splits documents into logical sections, implying hierarchy-awareness, but the evidence never explicitly describes preservation of heading levels or reading order fidelity. A community comment on Datalab's Chandra-OCR notes a structural fidelity gap (PDF-in should allow PDF-out for groundtruthing), suggesting output structure isn't fully faithful to source layout in all cases. missing for 10: explicit documentation of heading/section hierarchy retention, reading-order guarantees, and independent benchmarks confirming structural accuracy.
